NONE: › (especially of countries) the position of being the strongest and most powerful and therefore able to control others
（尤指國家的）霸權，支配權，領導權

example: The three nations competed for regional hegemony.
這三個國家就地區霸權展開爭奪。

NONE: › the occasion in AD 622 when the prophet Muhammad left Mecca and travelled to Medina. This date is the one from which the Islamic system of counting years is calculated.
伊斯蘭先知穆罕默德從麥加逃亡到麥迪那；伊斯蘭元年

example: The citizens of Medina received and supported Muhammad following the Hegira.
麥迪那的公民歡迎從麥加逃亡而來的穆罕默德。
